english.title: Knowingly / recklessly provide false information / documentation - Ukraine
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly or recklessly provided,

(A)_[information that was false in a material respect]_
(B)_[or produced a document that is not what it purported to be]_

namely **(..SPECIFY DETAILS..), for the purpose of obtaining a licence under regulation 9 of the Ukraine (European Union Financial Sanctions) (No.2) Regulations 2014
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 9(5) and 12(1) of the Ukraine (European Union Financial Sanctions) (No.2) Regulations 2014.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
knowingly / recklessly
provided false information in a material respect OR
provided / produced a document that is not what it purported to be
for the purpose of obtaining a licence

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 14 states that consent of the Attorney General is needed to bring proceedings for this offence, except for summary offences.
(ii) For provisions regarding the laying of proceedings, see regulation 13 for full detail of how proceedings may be brought in the relevant jurisdiction.
(iii) This offence may be committed by conduct wholly or partly outside the United Kingdom when it is the conduct of a UK national or a body incorporated or constituted under the law of the United Kingdom.
(iv) Document includes information recorded in any form and, in relation to information recorded otherwise than in legible form, references to its production include producing a copy of the information in legible form.

other.penalty:
Either way -

Summary: 12 months and/or a fine.
Indictment: 7 years imprisonment and/or fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

Note
In relation to an offence committed before section 154(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes in to force, the reference to 12 months imprisonment in relation to summary offences, above, is to be read as reference to 6 months imprisonment.
